# zerops_project_remote_logging (Resource)

Owns remote logging configuration for one project. Delete clears the snippet, certificate and forwarding type. Configuration and certificate are sensitive state-retained inputs; only type is readable.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Only forwarding type is readable. Configuration and certificate remain in sensitive state.
resource "zerops_project_remote_logging" "example" {
  project_id    = zerops_project.example.id
  syslog_config = "destination d_discard { file(\"/dev/null\"); }; log { source(s_src); destination(d_discard); };"
  certificate   = ""
  type          = "syslog"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String)
- `syslog_config` (String, Sensitive) syslog-ng snippet. Stored in Terraform state; remote content drift cannot be detected.

### Optional

- `certificate` (String, Sensitive)
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) Operation timeouts. One timeout covers lock acquisition, API requests, queued work and readiness polling. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `type` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>

- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/bin/sh
terraform import zerops_project_remote_logging.example 'PROJECT_ID'
```
